name: reference-workspace
query:
Create "Relay · Engineering · Skill test", a new private engineering workspace using fictional release context. Do not reuse or edit previous Relay pages. Release0.9 is retry-safe delivery. Next checkpoint Nov2 2026. The decision blocking rollout is lock scope for concurrent replay requests.

Add retry conflict response (Review,P1,Ari Kim,Oct30,API)—document conflict behavior and test same-key/different-payload handling. Show pending delivery state (Building,P1,Noor Ali,Nov2,Client)—show pending vs delivered and preserve accessible feedback. Add cleanup lag metric (Ready,P2,Sam,Nov3,Reliability)—instrument queue cleanup age and explain threshold selection. Replay integration tests (Done,P1,Ari,Oct28,API)—covers replay success and duplicate delivery. Delivery tracing (Done,P2,Sam,Oct28,Reliability)—correlates attempt and delivery IDs.
Docs: Retry-safe delivery spec (proposal awaiting lock decision): request key, durable deduplication, conflict behavior and rollout gates. Decision: retain seven-day replay keys (accepted in this fictional brief). Runbook: delayed delivery (current): inspect attempt/delivery correlation, distinguish pending from duplicate, collect evidence before retry; escalation and dashboard URLs not supplied.
Give engineers a clear release overview and useful technical library. No external issue tracker owns this fictional work. No invented commands, metrics or real user assignments.

context.execution: Live testing only when explicitly authorized; isolated private sample destinations. Otherwise supply a stateful mock.
